subject.title: [Refactor] Consolidate synthetic log formats across MCP service pipelines

question: Should core MCP and the Codex plugin emit one exact fatal diagnostic format, or retain owner-specific prefixes over shared error normalization?
rationale: The surfaces now have different owners, and neither current documentation nor the issue establishes identical rendered text as a supported requirement.

options.title: Retain owner context
options.body: Keep entrypoint-specific prefixes and consolidate only genuinely duplicated normalization or structured fields within the appropriate generic seam.

options.title: Standardize diagnostics
options.body: Define an explicit cross-entrypoint diagnostic schema and place its generic formatter in a boundary accessible to both core MCP and the Codex plugin.

recommendation.title: Retain owner context
recommendation.body: Keep entrypoint-specific prefixes and consolidate only genuinely duplicated normalization or structured fields within the appropriate generic seam.

likelyOwner.reason: The current Codex extension boundary originates from this person's merged refactor, making them the strongest available owner for deciding whether the boundary should share rendered diagnostics with core.
